# Virtual BillBoard (LiveBillboards.lol) — Complete System & Agent Specification

## 1. Executive Summary
Virtual BillBoard (https://livebillboards.lol) is a decentralized 24/7 Digital Out-of-Home (DOOH) and Live Stream advertising network built for humans and autonomous AI agents. It bridges physical venue TVs, creator live streams, and 200+ metropolitan web streams with real-time bidding (RTB), Solana USDC micro-settlements, and WebMCP 1.0 tool interfaces.

## 2. Full Architecture & Components

### 2.1 Web Model Context Protocol (WebMCP 1.0)
- Exposes standardized tool definitions for AI models (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Grok, Gemini).
- Schema location: `https://livebillboards.lol/.well-known/mcp.json`
- In-browser runtime: `window.webMCP` and `navigator.modelContext`
- 3 Core Streamlined Tools:
  1. `get_inventory`: `GET /api/billboard/active` & `GET /api/bid/floor`
  2. `preview_creative`: validates creative, estimates reach (14,200 impressions), checks Gemini safety
  3. `buy_slot`: `POST /api/bids/submit` with token burn & Proof-of-Play receipt generation

### 2.2 Proof-of-Play (PoP) Cryptographic Engine
- For every 15-second rotation, the backend generates a signed JSON receipt:
  - `actualDurationSeconds`: 14.85s guaranteed airtime
  - `activeSurfaces`: `['Global Web Live Stream', 'In-Venue Smart TV DOOH Network', 'Twitch / Kick Live Streamer Overlay']`
  - `verifiedQrScans`: real-time phone scans captured on dynamic redirect `/r/:rotationToken`
  - `uniqueDevices`: unique device fingerprint count
  - `creativeHash`: SHA-256 hash of title, image, and destination
  - `signature`: cryptographic platform HMAC-SHA256 stamp
- Accessible via `GET /api/proof/receipt/:receiptId` and `GET /api/user/receipts`

### 2.3 Dynamic 15-Second Rotating QR Code Attribution
- Dynamic URL: `https://livebillboards.lol/r/:rotationToken`
- Automatically logs scan timestamps and unique device signatures.
- Appends UTM attribution tags:
  `?utm_source=livebillboards&utm_medium=dooh_virtual_billboard&utm_campaign={city}&utm_term={slotId}&utm_content={rotationToken}`
- Sub-5ms `302 Redirect` to target destination.

### 2.4 Physical Smart TV Pairing Protocol (`/tv` & `/pair`)
- Accessible on any Smart TV browser (LG webOS, Samsung Tizen, Android TV, Fire TV, Apple TV).
- Displays a 6-digit PIN (e.g. `834-192`).
- Venue owners enter the PIN at `https://livebillboards.lol/pair` to bind their venue name and Solana wallet.
- Pays 70% automatic rev-share to the venue on all ads shown.

### 2.5 Live Streamer OBS Transparent Overlays (`/streamer` & `/overlay`)
- Transparent 1080p browser source overlay for OBS Studio and Streamlabs.
- Viewers bid on creator handles (`https://livebillboards.lol/@handle`).
- 80% revenue split paid to the creator.

### 2.6 Dual Settlement Highways
- **Fiat / Stripe**: 256-bit encrypted card processing ($1.00 USD = 1,000 Ad Tokens).
- **Solana USDC**: SPL token micro-settlements with sub-400ms finality and automated multi-party splits.

### 2.7 AI Content Moderation
- Instant regex heuristic filter + Google Gemini 2.5 Flash / Vision AI multimodal safety audit before screen display.
